text:
Leah Morales: RFC follow-up: proposing a 'cohorted demux' approach to peel the session+routing responsibilities out of the orchestration monolith. Goal: migrate tenants in small cohorts, move session ownership to a lightweight session-proxy, then evict state from monolith. Looking for safety net ideas and migration cadence.

Maya Patel: +1. main risks: state drift, cache consistency, and accidental stale reads during cutover. do we plan read-forward or read-merge?

Leah Morales: Read-merge for first two waves: proxy reads prefer new store, but fall back and asynchronously repair if old wins. Writes go to new store only after wave-2. That reduces double-write QPS.

Oren Katz: Nice. How do we handle rollbacks if we see p99 tail-up? Also what about tenants with very large working sets?

Sasha Liao: Ops constraints: any cohort that shows >12% p99 increase or >1% user-facing errors for 10m -> immediate weight rollback and isolate cohort. Preflight a 0.5% mirror window to validate metadata-heavy flows.

Aria (eng-sre): I'll own the experiment dashboard. Required signals: p50/p95/p99, request error rate, session-miss-rate, downstream queue depth, background repair backlog. Also track 'repair-success-rate' for async merges.

Leah Morales: For large tenants we propose a chunked-state-rollover: break their session keyspace into N shards and migrate one shard at a time with per-shard backpressure. Migration command (draft):
```
redwood session migrate --tenant $TENANT --shard 42 --strategy proxy-then-cut --verify p99,error_rate
```

Oren Katz: Add an opt-in header so SDKs can be targeted during first two waves: `X-SESSION-MIGRATE: shard-42`. That'll make debugging much faster.

Maya Patel: We also need a schema compat plan. Suggest stable decoding layer in proxy that understands v1/v2 keys and emits structured metric `session_key_version` per request.

Sasha Liao: Runbook snippet: if repair backlog > 5000 items for >15m, pause migrations for that cohort, and trigger a throttle on background repairs. Document escalation to infra.

infra-bot: RFC uploaded: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/cohorted-demux-v1. Related PRs: #4224, #4229. CI smoke job added: smoke/session-migrate. :robot_face:

Leah Morales: Next steps: spike (2w) to implement proxy decode layer + per-shard migration scaffold. Oren will prototype shard tooling, Maya will write the compat telemetry, Aria will build dashboards and the smoke test profile. Sasha please author runbook pages. Reconvene in 2w.

Maya Patel: One extra safety: automated smoke after each shard switch — 20 warmup requests then 200 sampled flows matching p95 shapes. If any step fails, weight -> 0 for that shard and create incident.

Oren Katz: I'll add a graceful backpressure token bucket on the proxy to limit repair QPS. Also will log per-shard repair latency.

Leah Morales: Thanks all — I'll post an updated RFC with the shard plan and rollback playbook. :thumbsup:
